BiblicalUsage: Kacam means to shear — the priests of the new temple were not to shave their heads or let their locks grow long, but to shear them, keeping a plain and ordered appearance before the LORD.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God cares about how His servants carry themselves, not for show but because order and restraint honour Him.
